en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate covered promenade or colonnade set among rows of trees. The iron or metal structure has decorative columns, arches, and finials on top, with a hanging lamp in the center. Several figures in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand or walk inside the hall. Red printed script at the bottom identifies the scene, and a red handwritten number '123' appears at the top right.
